coordinate_system: Y-up, -Z forward; one exported unit is one meter

integration.title: Crate Integration
integration.summary: Simple wooden aether-crystal supply crate. Pipeline proof-of-concept asset - modeled, textured, and exported headlessly from Blender.
integration.placement: Place anywhere crates make sense (cargo hold, bow deck near the existing JerryCanSupply crate). Single static mesh, no moving parts.

nodes.name: Crate
nodes.role: The entire prop; one static mesh.

setup_steps: Import without a rig or animation clips.
Add a box collider matching the mesh bounds.

Assign the URP/Lit shader to the imported material and confirm Crate_BaseColor.png is on Base Map; Crate_Roughness.png is authored as a plain grayscale roughness map (not yet packed into a Metallic/Smoothness alpha channel - repack or wire a Smoothness slot mapped from inverted roughness if the target shader wants smoothness instead); Crate_Bump.png is a grayscale height map (non-color) - wire it into a Bump/Height slot if the target shader has one, otherwise it can be skipped.
integration.collision: Single box collider matching the mesh bounds.

bundles.description: Static wooden crate, single mesh, three baked textures (base color + roughness + bump).
